# Coric Aseprite fixture

These unmodified files come from [Coric's Quest](https://github.com/tung/corics-quest/tree/215476b69b39080ecd287704d78ced6f0fffbe68/assets), revision `215476b69b39080ecd287704d78ced6f0fffbe68`. The JSON identifies Aseprite `1.3.5-dev` as its exporter. The fixture tests a real JSON-array export with 12 frames, different durations, and animation tags. It does not contain trimmed frames or pivot slices.

The character sprites were adapted by Tung Nguyen from the [Tiny 16: Basic](https://opengameart.org/content/tiny-16-basic) character templates by Lanea Zimmerman. The upstream [attribution](https://github.com/tung/corics-quest/blob/215476b69b39080ecd287704d78ced6f0fffbe68/README.md) offers the assets under CC BY 4.0, among other licenses. This copy uses [CC BY 4.0](LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0.txt). The upstream project's [MIT license](LICENSE-MIT.txt) is also included. Malvado has not modified these files.
